description:
Client Library for Service Manager

        Migration Guide (for migration from Service Manager Client 3.X.X and 4.X.X version under com.sap.cloud.instancemanager group id)

        What changed:

        1. Package namespace change (CRITICAL)
           All packages have been renamed:
             Old: com.sap.xsa.core.instancemanager.client
             New: com.sap.cloud.servicemanager.client
           All imports must be updated throughout your codebase.

        2. Removed classes
           - ImClientTimeoutException       - Removed. Timeout errors now wrapped in base ImClientException
           - ManagedServiceInstanceSource   - Removed. No longer distinguishes between SERVICE_MANAGER and INSTANCE_MANAGER sources
           - DefaultPlan                    - Removed. Pass plan parameters directly to factory methods
           - Public concrete implementation classes of the interfaces were removed, please use the public interfaces provided

        3. Method signature changes
           Method names changed from plural to singular:
             isKeepLastCreatedBindings()  ->  isKeepLastCreatedBinding()
             setKeepLastCreatedBindings() ->  setKeepLastCreatedBinding()
             isKeepLastValidBindings()    ->  isKeepLastValidBinding()
             setKeepLastValidBindings()   ->  setKeepLastValidBinding()

        4. Removed fields and methods
           - RebindOptions.deletionTime  - Removed. Old bindings are now deleted immediately after creating new ones
                                           (if keepPreviousBindings=false). Deferred deletion timing is no longer configurable.
           - ErrorInfo.UNKNOWN constant  - Removed

        Steps:

        1. Update the dependency in your pom.xml:
             Old (version 4.x):
               groupId:    com.sap.xsa.core.instancemanager
               artifactId: client
               version:    4.x.x

             New (version 1.10.0):
               groupId:    com.sap.cloud.servicemanager
               artifactId: client
               version:    1.10.0

        2. Update all imports from com.sap.xsa.core.instancemanager.* to com.sap.cloud.servicemanager.*

        3. Remove any usage of removed classes:
             - ImClientTimeoutException       -> catch ImClientException instead
             - ManagedServiceInstanceSource   -> remove usages
             - DefaultPlan                    -> remove usages

        4. Remove RebindOptions.setDeletionTime() calls - deletion timing is no longer configurable
